field_rules.aliases: KNOWN = documentary variants seen in sources (not adjudicated); PENDING_VERIFICATION = member of an unresolved group

field_rules.event_status: UNKNOWN = no event recorded: absence of records is not absence of activations
field_rules.geometry: KNOWN only from a reproducible repository record; PENDING_VERIFICATION = lead only (e.g. faja marginal, never a footprint)
field_rules.outlet: a vulnerable-population point is not an outlet
field_rules.parent_basin: only when documented; never inferred by proximity
field_rules.persistent_reference: KNOWN = unit-level reference (URL, document id, archive, or source URL + table/row); PENDING_VERIFICATION = document only
field_rules.primary_document: KNOWN = source text verified or record archived with SHA-256 (an archived record page is not a verified reading)

COMPOUND_NAME_REVIEW.meaning: the documentary name joins several labels; flagged, never split here

CROSS_PR_OVERLAP.meaning: a delta row overlaps the master or another delta (same id or same name and district); not integrated

DOCUMENTARY_RELATION_UNRESOLVED.meaning: a recorded relation (alias group, pending identity group, unnamed event) is unresolved

EVENT_EVIDENCE_WITHOUT_VERIFIED_SOURCE.meaning: an event counted as verified while its source text is not verified

EXACT_RECORD_DUPLICATE.meaning: the same inventory_id appears more than once inside one input

FAJA_MARGINAL_AS_FOOTPRINT.meaning: a faja marginal delimitation is used as geometry or flood footprint

GUARD_VIOLATION.meaning: an input lost a RESEARCH_ONLY / TEST_ONLY guard

HOMONYM_DISTINCT_CONTEXT.meaning: same normalised name in different districts or departments; not merged

IDENTIFIER_CONFLICT.meaning: a persistent identifier contradicts another record (e.g. a replaced id is still present)

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.meaning: no persistent reference or only secondary / non-institutional sources

LEDGER_CROSS_REFERENCE.meaning: a system-level ledger entry shares a name with documentary rows (different granularity)

MASTER_RULES_VIOLATION.meaning: the master's own validator rejects the master

POTENTIAL_ALIAS.meaning: same or near-same normalised name in the same territory under different ids; human review, never a merge

PROMOTION_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE.meaning: map eligibility claimed without reproducible geometry, outlet and recorded QA

REFERENTIAL_INTEGRITY.meaning: a reference to an inventory id that no loaded input contains

SIDECAR_REJECTED.meaning: an annotation of the sidecar breaks its rules

SOURCE_REFERENCE_CONFLICT.meaning: the same document identifier carries contradictory document metadata in different rows

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_NOT_ABSENCE.meaning: a capture or sweep failed (HTTP 404, blocked, timeout): a pending source, never an absence
